description: This file defines the React component 'TenantBootstrap', which manages tenant selection and routing logic based on session tenants. It handles redirects to the appropriate pages depending on whether tenants are present, the count of tenants, and the current location. It involves fetching session tenants, normalizing tenant IDs, and conditionally navigating within the app.

methods.name: TenantBootstrap()
methods.description: A React functional component that executes tenant bootstrap logic once per page lifecycle, determining navigation based on tenant session state.
